name: dialog-lightbox
description: A lightweight lightbox on the native <dialog>: swipe, zoom, video. It adds behavior; the markup and CSS stay yours.
author: Maximilian Fettinger

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --minify --target=browser --outfile=dist/dialog-lightbox.js && cp src/dialog-lightbox.css dist/ && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:demo: rm -rf site && bun build demo/index.html --outdir=site --minify && cp -R demo/media site/media
scripts.check:types: bun run build && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --lib es2023,dom,dom.iterable --types '' dist/types/index.d.ts
